name: IRIS - Investing: EDGAR Fundamentals Feed
description: Rate-limit-safe SEC EDGAR companyfacts feed. Fills fundamentals for securities missing coverage: fetches XBRL facts (identity UA header + throttle) into inv.facts, computes annual-basis fundamentals into inv.fundamentals. Nightly + manual. Zero regression

parameters.jsCode: const d=$input.first().json;const ciks=(d&&d.ciks)||[];function pad(n){var s=String(n);while(s.length<10){s='0'+s;}return s;}return ciks.map(function(c){return {json:{cik:Number(c),url:'https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK'+pad(c)+'.json'}};});
